name: UnrollingAction
description: Replicate loop body a fixed number of times to reduce loop overhead and increase instruction-level parallelism. Exposes more independent operations for out-of-order execution.

parameters.name: unroll_factor
parameters.description: Number of times to replicate the loop body. Typical values: 2, 4, 8. Higher values increase ILP but may increase register pressure.

parameters.name: target_loop_index
parameters.description: Index of the target loop to unroll, counting from innermost (0) to outermost. Default: 0 (innermost).
